characters.name: Cassia of the Lighthouse
characters.design: Adult woman, dark curly hair and blue hood, ivory/pale-blue split layered cloth, water glass charms, worn silver clasps, crescent orb staff. Compact mist and droplets.

characters.name: Brennic the Red
characters.design: Adult broad-shouldered man, shaved dark head and short copper beard, pale warm ivory layered battle cloth with burnt-orange split sash, dark short shoulder mantle, ember jars and hammered rings on belt, forked charred staff cradling an ember. Compact embers and heat.

characters.name: Garran Stonehand
characters.design: Older powerful man, deep brown skin and thick short greying beard, broad pale ochre hooded shoulder wrap over ivory layered cloth, stone charms and leather pouches, heavy gnarled staff with angular stone head. Floating stone motes and compact dust.

characters.name: Iskar Windborn
characters.design: Lean adult man, copper skin, long black hair tied high behind swept pale lilac hood, ivory layered cloth with two narrow trailing lilac panels, silver wire charms and belt tools, slender bifurcated silver-bound staff. Sparse wind wisps and tiny branching lightning.

characters.name: Elder Sadruba
characters.design: Older woman, broad severe face, dark mahogany skin, tightly coiled white hair cropped at one side, heavy brow and small old cheek scar. Ivory battle mantle with muted ember-red folds and worn copper clasp. Commanding fire elder, plain dark bronze collar, coal charm.

characters.name: Elder Ophel
characters.design: Older slender man, sallow olive skin, long hooked nose, close-cropped white curls and short square white beard. Hooded dark eyes, wary dry expression. Ivory and faded blue layered robe, silver ledger-key charm, plain dark bronze collar. Water elder.

characters.name: Elder Ruadh
characters.design: Older stout woman, russet freckled skin, round strong face, pale grey eyes and thick silver hair wrapped in a loose braid crown. Soft ochre and ivory shawls with flour-worn cuffs, stone bead clasp and plain bronze collar. Enduring earth elder.

characters.name: Elder Kesh
characters.design: Older lean man with weathered copper skin, deep smile creases, nearly bald scalp with long grey side braids, narrow dark eyes and small pointed grey beard. Pale lilac scarf over cream travel layers, small trade weights on cord, plain bronze collar. Amused air elder.

characters.name: Corvo
characters.design: Young adult man with pale olive skin, broad angular jaw, close-cut coal-black hair and a crooked nose, clean-shaven. Proud challenging eyes. Light ivory layered battle cloth, torn rust-red shoulder sash, worn copper rings and plain bronze collar. Fire rival.

characters.name: Nysa
characters.design: Adult woman with warm medium brown skin, oval face, wide-set dark eyes, black hair in a thick loose braid and a knowing half-smile. Pale blue and ivory layered cloth, small sea-glass charms and plain bronze collar. Charming water rival.

characters.name: Senna
characters.design: Adult woman with deep brown skin, strong square face, shaven head, level heavy brows and small eyebrow scar. Steady formal gaze. Pale ochre layered shoulder cloth, ivory wrap, carved stone clasp and plain bronze collar. Athletic earth rival.

characters.name: Lio
characters.design: Young adult man with tawny skin, narrow face, unruly auburn curls, faint moustache and a lopsided broad smile. Ivory travel cloth with lavender neck scarf, small silver wire charms and plain bronze collar. Reckless air rival.

characters.name: Fenna
characters.design: Young adult woman with light brown skin, sharp heart-shaped face, short uneven black hair tucked behind one ear and quick wary eyes. Worn pale lilac patched hood over ivory layers, small concealed pouch strap and plain bronze collar. Clever outcast; resilient, no glamorous costume.

characters.name: Old Quill
characters.design: Very old gaunt man with pale weathered skin, deeply furrowed face, wispy white hair around bald crown and untidy long white beard. Uneven alert eyes. Frayed cream and ochre scholar layers, broken plain stone pendant and plain bronze collar. An ignored deserter scholar.

characters.name: Warden Septima
characters.design: Middle-aged woman with cool olive skin, severe narrow face, straight dark hair tightly bound at the nape and piercing grey eyes. Structured ivory and black salt-warden robes, sparse silver angular clasps, dignified rigid posture. Uncollared official: absolutely NO prisoner neck collar. No crown.

characters.name: Lanista Aulus Venno
characters.design: Middle-aged heavyset man with warm pale skin, broad fleshy face, neat short dark curls greying at temples, clean-shaven and calculating eyes. Rich but restrained cream civic drapery with muted purple seam, dull gold shoulder pin. Uncollared games official: absolutely NO prisoner neck collar. No crown.
